key_findings: Innate fear odor 2MT produces analgesia in acute and chronic pain models without motor impairment.
Anterior piriform cortex GABAergic neurons are selectively activated by 2MT and are necessary and sufficient for fear-induced analgesia via the mediodorsal thalamus.
